ideal: Small changes reach production soon after they merge, automatically, rarely fail, and are restored within the hour when one does.

parts.ideal: Each merge to main deploys with no hand step
parts.setup: Cloudflare Workers Builds on the production branch, or a GitHub Pages workflow on push to main

parts.ideal: No merge waits for production, and none waits a day
parts.setup: Deploy on every merge; fix a stuck build the day it sticks

parts.ideal: The latest deploy went live within a day of its earliest merge
parts.setup: Small pull requests that ship one at a time

parts.ideal: At most 5% of deploys roll back or ship a regression; the latest one holds
parts.setup: Checks gate each merge; name the culprit in a Regressed-by line on the regression issue

parts.ideal: A failed deploy is restored within an hour
parts.setup: Roll back first and fix after: a Wrangler rollback, or a redeploy of the last good commit

parts.ideal: The push behind a deploy bills under 20 Actions minutes
parts.setup: Path filters, caches and one shared workflow
